hooks.name: research-data-check
hooks.description: Check saved case and verification data against the data contract and .kiro/steering/research-data.md. Switch to a command action running `npm run --silent validate:data` once that script exists (data-contract tasks).

action.prompt: A case or verification data file was saved. Check it against the data contract (.kiro/specs/data-contract/) and .kiro/steering/research-data.md: every document version has documentId, versionId, title, publisher and a sourceUrl or an explicit missing value; every evidence row points to an existing document version and has an anchor and a short original-language excerpt (news at most 200 characters, official documents at most 300); translations are labelled and never used as evidence; every date has a kind and the format YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, YYYY or unknown, and no date was computed from another; URLs contain no U+2236 or U+00B7 look-alike characters, and null, empty or "unknown" URLs count as missing; every path has evidenceRefs that resolve, and no path is marked confirmed unless all of its evidence passed the evidence gate; only rows that passed the loading gate are present. Report each problem with its JSON path or id. Do not invent or fill in missing values.
